info.title: TraceFlow API
info.description: Comprehensive API for the TraceFlow backend, managing users, roles, permissions, and more. Authentication uses Keycloak with an `accessToken` cookie, validated via introspection. Authorization requires specific permissions checked via Keycloak UMA tickets. Rate limiting applies to sensitive endpoints.

cookieAuth.name: accessToken
cookieAuth.description: Requires `accessToken` cookie from Keycloak login. Validated via Keycloak introspection.

post.description:
### POST /api/auth/login

**Purpose**: Creates auth for login.

**Context**: Handles authentication flows, including login, 2FA, token refresh, and password reset. Uses Keycloak for token validation. No permissions required.

**Rate Limiting**:
- `noOpLimiter`: Custom rate limiting applied.

**Notes**:
- Responses include detailed error messages for debugging.
- Logs are generated for all requests using the custom logger.

429.description: Too many requests. Please try again later.
